Pilot 3 roles x 2 cases, original criteria shown BEFORE contested solution/reviews:
A: task-c4460fbd65a244419650fc5ef5669a6f original spec v1 blob df17c3baab0bd4eb3e3e6c0e39cfda70c2c1cbc6. Real owner-activity CAS failures in reviews 89a50286124147cf9bdd99657d102f44 and 6fd76f4209ba4f75a86b05426e93803e; 287ef750/24813afc5b7b4b09aef0318632697a3c extended to native reaping/fleet gates; evaluate whether mandatory OS proof is necessary vs correct ingress fence plus truthful refusal. B: simplify-lifecycle-versions original spec v1 blob 79778cfc4e557cca148b5059c92ef69bb60e3acb. Same-task/same-owner gen1 old session mutates gen2 on zero version lookup at frozen 23a6a558 / review 274c7f54873f46d69364d346a5711f21. Calibrate only afterward against corrected 90689856 / review c1943c719fa94e4997909c92dca999a5.

Three prompts (all max 180 words, same output schema): Critical Senior Dev—challenge extra proof obligation, cite criterion/counterexample/minimal fix and condition when extra work truly is required. Standard Reviewer—independently classify must-fix correctness vs newly invented blockers relative original/current acceptance. Pragmatic Lead—choose smallest safe delivery, autonomously resolve normal requirements, separate optional work and identify only strategic operator ambiguity.

Lead launches six *separate* agents, same model/effort/budget/evidence order when controllable. Preserve run IDs, exact input/frozen Git and spec OIDs, complete raw answers, UTC timestamps and elapsed time, host-reported input/output tokens or unavailable, tool/coordination calls, and retries. Score original-criterion link, observable causality, minimal remedy, justified-expansion condition and independence 0-2 each; identify false-positive refusal of real race and false-negative OS proof as invented gate. No invented timings/tokens/results; no rollout or main merge. Lead retains decision authority. Docs-only follow-up review is pending lock contention, not accepted.
